title: Valid Parentheses
statement: The string contains only the six bracket characters. Return true when every bracket is closed by the matching type in the correct order.
hints: Counting brackets is not enough: the string ([)] has balanced counts but is wrong.
Push every opening bracket. On a closing bracket, the most recent unmatched opener must be its partner.
That is exactly a stack. Reject on a mismatch or on a closing bracket with an empty stack, and require the stack to be empty at the end.
